label: PawTrail
instructions: Work directly in the registered standalone game workspace. Read its AGENTS.md first. The social app is a separate worktree; copy only explicitly authorized modules and assets. Preserve actual shadcn/ui components and Tailwind layout, Saira Condensed headings and Instrument Sans body text. Native manifests govern dimensions, animation counts and integer nearest-neighbor rendering. Project instructions govern agents, tests, builds and Firefox verification; the profile grants none of those independently. Local authoring state and prototype Kibble are not authoritative server records.

authoring.representation_basis: Owner's standing 2D furniture batch workflow; honor any newer explicit choice.
authoring.style: Preserve canonical native art, warm light/middle/shadow divisions and existing thin brown contours. Keep transparent RGBA; do not double-outline finished sprites.
authoring.backend_authority: Keep existing lit/open/counter fields, idempotent actions, inventory, revision and occupancy rules. Preserve prices and inventory IDs. A preview is local and does not prove live account persistence.
